Asset type: architectural concept comparison sheet, CLOSE THE DEAL / kit detail round 4.
Create ONE LANDSCAPE 16:9 sheet, largest practical resolution (target 3840x2160). Two equal direction columns A left, B right. Each column has TWO substantial INTERIOR renders: HERO above, PLAY below. Place one SMALL rival-street inset inside the bottom-right corner of EACH PLAY render; inset area roughly one quarter of that play panel. Thus FOUR main interiors and TWO small street insets, NEVER give street views a full row. Slim white margins/header. Exact direction captions supplied below, one sentence each; small tags HERO / 1.7 M EYE, PLAY / 1.7 M EYE, and inset RIVAL / 12 M / 3 FLOORS. No material swatches, diagrams or dimension arrows.
REFERENCE ROLES: reference_board_r4.png is the STYLE reference: its top row bible01-03 means airy 1999-2003 editorial design, pale translucent layers, thin grids, sky photography, immense negative space; its bottom row establishes white/cobalt city and the approved office. plate_law_office_floor.png is the ROOM/kit reference for open floor, practical carpet, small meeting enclosures, service spine; plate_law_firm_atrium.png is LIGHT/material reference. contact_sheet_r3.png is PREVIOUS CONCEPT reference ONLY for selected carved features, NEVER copy its generic contemporary office aesthetic or equal-weight street layout. Do not copy plants, rail bars, lettering or logos from reference images.
STYLE PRIORITY: unmistakably a multinational's optimistic 2001 VISION of the future, with architectural Frutiger Aero and Gen X Soft Club. NOT today's minimalist coworking interior. Clean radiused recesses and capsule light coves meeting sharp white planes, satin and glossy white like early-2000s consumer electronics/airport lounges, brushed silver edges, near-clear sky-filled glazing, selective cyan-to-white softness ONLY in high frosted inserts/cove lighting. Brand-managed thin spaced sans floor/department codes, tiny technical type and a few hairline rules; blue-sky photographic wall inserts where specified. Empty air and sparse mundane copier/desks/chairs. Curves precisely architectural, NEVER blobby. No plants/greenery, bubbles, droplets, pink chrome, rainbow/pastel gradients, vaporwave, neon/cyberpunk, pipes/greeble, blinds, grime or mirror-dark glass.
RETAIN round3 BOLDNESS: big CARVED geometry, storey-scale cobalt, one primary architectural move per direction, hard raking sun and deep shadow cuts. White about65% architecture, cobalt secondary structural fields, navy recesses, silver; cyan one thin accent, not broad glowing blue architecture. Polished lit real-time environment painting/render with crisp geometry, GI, restrained edge bloom, cobalt sky and atmospheric depth. Façade sun penetrates DEEP into interior, hard mullion shadows across matte grey-blue carpet and white walls, cool bounce, darker but chromatically alive core. Traceable long shadow edges in every main view; gloss has sky highlights without obscuring people.

Service OPENING1200x2400mm and silver leaf1180x2380x40mm remain rectangular and unchanged. Every variant inside original outer bounds, pivots, flat snap end lands and contact faces; NO new projection above15mm, prefer0mm. All bold relief is visibly CUT INWARD, with a cavity back smaller/BEHIND the original silhouette and lit cut sidewalls.
